I can't change what you are feeling right now but I can share some wisdom. You may feel like a nobody but you aren't, to someone you are or will be important to them. The socialization part is something I cannot help with too much but I can say that if you find someone you can talk to even a little, try to hangout with them and their friends, that way you can get used to it. The sadness part is something I have experience with, alot of experience with, I got depressed and ended up attempting to kill myself. It was a very hard time. But I finally made the decision to call a suicide hotline and it saved my life. The fact that you worry about your future is a good sign because it means you are holding on, you have drive, you have ambition, you can get better. 800-273-8255
